sender.ip_domain: Domain is a raw IP address ({domain}) instead of a hostname
sender.long_address: Email address is unusually long ({length} chars) — typical addresses are under 50 characters
sender.url_shortener: Domain ({domain}) is a known URL shortening service frequently abused in phishing
sender.multiple_at: Address contains {count} @ symbols — invalid email format
sender.double_slash: Domain contains '//' — possible redirect deception trick
sender.domain_hyphen: Domain contains a hyphen ({domain}) — major providers typically do not use hyphens in their domains
sender.deep_subdomains: Domain has {count} subdomain levels — phishing sites commonly use deep subdomains to impersonate brands
sender.http_token: Email address contains the token 'http' — used to create visual confusion
sender.unrecognized_provider: Domain ({domain}) is not a recognized legitimate mail provider
sender.uncommon_tld: TLD '.{tld}' is uncommon — phishing emails often use obscure or cheap TLDs
sender.long_domain_label: Domain label is unusually long ({length} characters)
sender.domain_digits: Domain label contains digits ({label}) — legitimate brand domains are usually letters only
sender.high_risk_tld: TLD '.{tld}' is a known high-risk or free domain extension heavily used in phishing campaigns
sender.long_username: Username is unusually long ({length} characters) — typical usernames are under 30 characters
sender.homoglyph_brand: Homoglyph attack detected — '{label}' uses character substitution to impersonate '{brand}' (e.g. 1→l, 0→o, vv→w)
sender.character_substitution: Character substitution detected in domain '{label}' — normalized to '{normalized}'
sender.abused_cctld: TLD '.{tld}' is a country-code domain commonly abused in phishing attacks
sender.malformed_syntax: Email address has unsupported or malformed mailbox syntax.
sender.fake_financial_business: Domain '{domain}' follows an [abbreviation]+[financial term]+[business suffix] pattern ({breakdown}) — a known technique used to fabricate fake financial institution email domains
sender.financial_business_combo: Domain '{domain}' combines financial keywords ({financial}) with business entity suffixes ({suffixes}) — pattern commonly seen in financial phishing and business email compromise (BEC) domains
sender.financial_keywords: Domain '{domain}' contains financial-sector keywords ({financial}) on an unverified provider — verify the sender before sharing financial or personal information
sender.business_suffix: Domain '{domain}' uses a business entity suffix ({suffixes}) but is not a recognized or verified organization
sender.brand_substring: Domain '{domain}' contains the name of a well-known brand ({brands}) as a substring but is not the official domain — possible typosquatting or brand impersonation
sender.government_keywords: Domain '{domain}' contains government/regulatory keywords ({keywords}) but is NOT a .gov/.mil domain — likely impersonating an official body
sender.compound_domain: Domain label '{label}' is long ({length} chars) and appears to be a compound of multiple words — bulk phishing campaigns often generate such domains to appear business-like
sender.random_username: Username '{username}' matches {score}/6 randomness factors ({factors}) — the mailbox pattern looks automatically generated, but account age and lifetime cannot be confirmed
sender.disposable_domain_pattern: Domain ({domain}) resembles a temporary-email provider name, but is not in the confirmed provider registry
sender.known_disposable: Known disposable-email provider detected ({provider}). Provider category alone is not phishing evidence; mailbox lifetime is unknown.
sender.privacy_relay: Privacy relay or masked-address provider detected ({provider}); this is not phishing evidence by itself.
sender.plus_alias: Address uses plus subaddressing; the tag is not a phishing signal.
sender.list_rewritten: Sender domain was rewritten by a mailing list (.invalid suffix); the original domain was scored.
content.hidden_text_padding: Large hidden text block accompanies an image-dominant linked message; the visible message differs substantially from its hidden text. Review the image and destination manually.
content.password_form: Embedded HTML form contains a password field; inspect the submission destination before entering credentials.
content.pressured_credential_request: Direct credential request combined with urgency and threats; verify through an independent channel.
content.sensitive_request.one_time_code: Asks you to send, reply with or read out a one-time or verification code; genuine services only ask you to enter it on their own site or app.
content.sensitive_request.password_pin: Asks you to send or share a password or PIN; legitimate organizations never ask for these by email.
content.sensitive_request.recovery_secre: Asks for backup codes, a recovery or seed phrase, or a private key; anyone with these can take over the account or wallet.
content.sensitive_request.gift_card: Asks you to buy gift cards or send their numbers; gift cards are a common scam payment method.
content.sensitive_request.crypto_transfe: Asks you to move funds or crypto to a 'new', 'safe' or 'secure' wallet or account; no bank or exchange asks this.
content.sensitive_request.remote_access: Asks you to install remote-access software or share your screen; this lets someone control your device.
content.shortened_urls: Contains shortened URLs (bit.ly, tinyurl, etc.) — hides the true destination domain
content.exclamation_marks: Excessive exclamation marks ({count}) — emotional manipulation tactic common in scam emails
content.capitalization: Excessive capitalization ({percent}% uppercase) — used to simulate alarm and urgency
content.subject_question_marks: Multiple question marks in subject line ({count}) — manipulative rhetorical device
content.url_count: Unusually high number of URLs ({count}) — suggests bulk phishing template
content.generic_greeting: Generic impersonal greeting (Dear Customer/User/Valued Member) — legitimate services address you by name
content.large_amounts: Implausibly large monetary amounts mentioned: {amounts} — hallmark of advance-fee and lottery scams
content.generic_cta: Generic call-to-action phrases used {count}× ('click here', 'click now') — legitimate emails use descriptive link text
content.regional_phrasing: Regional or formal English phrasing observed: "{phrase}"; not included in the risk score.
content.regional_phrasing_more: Regional or formal English phrasing observed: "{phrase}"...; not included in the risk score.
content.obfuscation: Character substitution / homoglyph obfuscation detected for: {brands} — e.g. P@yP@l, Amaz0n — used to evade spam filters
link.obfuscated_scheme: Link uses an obfuscated hxxp/hxxps destination scheme.
link.malformed_target: Link contains a malformed destination that could not be safely parsed.
link.unsafe_scheme: Link uses an unsafe destination scheme ({scheme}:).
link.url_userinfo: Link destination uses URL userinfo before the real host, a common trusted-domain deception technique.
link.ipfs_gateway: Link destination ({host}) is an IPFS gateway: content-addressed pages there cannot be taken down by the brand they imitate and are common in phishing.
link.ip_host: Link destination uses an IP address instead of a domain name; inspect it before opening.
link.display_mismatch: Link display domain ({display_host}) does not match the actual destination ({host}).
link.idn_confusable: Link destination ({host}) is an IDN/confusable lookalike for {brand}.
link.brand_lookalike: Link destination ({host}) is a noncanonical lookalike for {brand}.
link.credential_collection_host: Link destination ({host}) combines credential and collection wording.
link.sensitive_host: Link destination ({host}) uses account-related wording on an unrecognized domain; this alone does not establish phishing.
structure.verified_official_sender: Verified sender: a trusted DMARC pass shows this message came from {organization}'s own domain ({domain}). Its links and requests are still checked.
structure.brand_display_name: Protected brand identity '{brand}' is displayed from an unrelated domain ({domain}).
structure.idn_sender_domain: Sender domain ({domain}) is a Unicode/IDN confusable for {brand}.
structure.no_visible_recipient: No visible To or Cc recipient is present; the message may have used Bcc.
structure.self_addressed: Self-addressed message: a From mailbox also appears in To or Cc.
structure.routing_mismatch: {header} domain ({domain}) differs from From domain candidates ({from_domains}). Routing differs; this alone does not establish impersonation.
structure.archive_attachment: Archive attachment requires inspection before opening: {filename}.
warning.mso_conditional: MSO conditional content has client-dependent rendering; analysis is incomplete.
warning.malformed_html: Malformed HTML required recovery; analysis is incomplete.
warning.link_unparsed: A link destination could not be reliably parsed; analysis is incomplete.
warning.hidden_html_text: Hidden HTML text was excluded from text scoring; visual rendering was not fully verified, so analysis is incomplete.
warning.stylesheet_visibility: A stylesheet may hide or reveal text; CSS rendering was not verified, so the affected text-model view was not scored.
warning.inline_css_visibility: Inline CSS may conceal text; its rendering was not verified, so the affected text-model view was not scored.
warning.image_alt_fallback: Image alternative text may be shown when an image is unavailable; that rendering was not verified, so the affected text-model view was not scored.
warning.mime_alternative_limit: MIME alternative view limit reached; not every rendered version was model-scored. Analysis is incomplete.
warning.mime_alternative_model: At least one MIME alternative could not be model-scored; analysis is incomplete.
warning.inline_images: Embedded image content was not inspected; analysis is incomplete.
warning.remote_images: Remote image content was not inspected; analysis is incomplete.
warning.unresolved_images: Unresolved image references were not inspected; analysis is incomplete.
warning.han_text: Substantial Han-script text detected; language-specific phishing checks are limited and this content may not be fully evaluated.
warning.model_insufficient_context: The message contains too little text for reliable model scoring; ML classification was not applied.
warning.model_insufficient_coverage: Text model feature coverage is insufficient; ML classification was not applied.
warning.attachments_uninspected: Attachment content was not inspected; only filenames and MIME types were checked. Analysis is incomplete.
warning.duplicate_mime_headers: Duplicate MIME headers ({headers}) are ambiguous; bounded alternate inspection, analysis is incomplete.
warning.mime_candidate_limit: MIME candidate limit reached; additional interpretations were not inspected.
warning.opaque_eml_attachment: Opaque .eml attachment was not parsed as an encapsulated message; analysis is incomplete.
warning.mime_decoding_fallback: MIME text decoding required a fallback or replacement; analysis may be incomplete.
warning.mime_resource_limit: MIME parser resource limit reached; only outer headers were inspected, body and attachments were not analyzed. Analysis is incomplete.
warning.header_unparsed: {header} header could not be parsed; raw value preserved, analysis is incomplete.
warning.duplicate_header: Duplicate {header} headers are ambiguous; all candidates inspected, analysis is incomplete.
warning.attached_message_empty: Attached message has no analyzable content; analysis is incomplete.
warning.mime_malformed: MIME structure is incomplete or malformed ({defects}); analysis may be incomplete.
warning.attached_message_encoded: Transfer-encoded attached message was not inspected; analysis is incomplete.
warning.attached_message_unparsed: Attached message could not be parsed; analysis is incomplete.
warning.attached_message_limit: Attached-message depth/count limit reached; analysis is incomplete.
warning.auth_results_incomplete: Authentication-Results syntax is incomplete; authentication claims require review.
warning.visual_text_limit: Email text exceeded the visual submission text limit; analysis is incomplete.
warning.visual_independent_sources: OCR and each distinct QR payload were assessed independently. Risk and rule scores retain the strongest individual assessment; the model score, when available, is the highest individual source score.
warning.visual_unverified: Image evidence was extracted in the browser and is not independently verified. OCR and QR recognition may miss content; image safety and malware were not assessed.
warning.ocr_verify_urls: Verify website addresses against the original image character by character. OCR can confuse 1/l/I or 0/O and break URL punctuation, even with high confidence. The original OCR text is preserved; no address spelling has been verified.
warning.enhanced_failed: Enhanced recognition failed; browser OCR and QR results were retained.
warning.enhanced_unverified: Additional recognition is unverified; original browser text and QR payloads are preserved.
warning.enhanced_model_output: Model-generated observations and URLs do not establish legitimacy and do not change the risk verdict.
safety.unsubscribe: Contains unsubscribe link — typical of legitimate bulk emails
safety.privacy_policy: Mentions privacy policy — sign of compliance
safety.not_requested: Acknowledges you may not have requested this
safety.web_version: Provides web version link — common in legitimate newsletters
safety.receiving_reason: Explains why the email was sent
verify.format_invalid: Enter a single supported email address with an unquoted ASCII local part and a valid domain.
verify.dns_timeout: DNS lookup timed out or was unavailable.
verify.null_mx: Domain publishes Null MX: it does not accept email. This is not evidence of phishing.
verify.invalid_null_mx: Invalid mixed or nonzero-preference Null MX records; mail service is inconclusive.
verify.domain_not_found: Domain does not exist in DNS.
verify.address_record_fallback: No MX record found; domain has an {record_type} record — using domain directly.
verify.no_mail_records: Domain has no MX, A, or AAAA records.
verify.deadline_after_dns: Verification deadline reached after DNS lookup.
verify.check_busy: Verification capacity is busy; this check was not run.
verify.smtp_disabled: SMTP mailbox probing is unavailable on this deployment.
verify.smtp_disabled_reason: SMTP mailbox probing is unavailable on this deployment; domain evidence does not prove that the mailbox exists.
verify.smtp_port_blocked: Port 25 appears blocked by your network. MX records exist, so the domain is real, but mailbox existence cannot be confirmed.
verify.smtp_non_public_target: SMTP target for {host} is non-public or could not be validated.
verify.smtp_no_such_mailbox: Mail server reports no such mailbox (SMTP {smtp_code}): {response}
verify.smtp_policy_rejected: Policy rejection does not establish mailbox existence (SMTP {smtp_code}): {response}
verify.smtp_mailbox_full: Mailbox full; not evidence of a nonexistent address (SMTP {smtp_code}): {response}
verify.smtp_temporary_error: Server returned a temporary error (SMTP {smtp_code}) — try again later
verify.spf_strict: Strict policy (-all): unauthorized senders are rejected.
verify.spf_softfail: Soft-fail policy (~all): unauthorized senders are flagged but not blocked.
verify.spf_neutral: Neutral policy (?all): no enforcement — spoofing possible.
verify.spf_open: Open policy (+all): ANY server may send — high spoofing risk!
verify.spf_unclear: SPF record found but enforcement policy is unclear.
verify.spf_missing: No SPF record — this domain is vulnerable to email spoofing.
verify.no_txt_records: No TXT records found for domain.
verify.dmarc_reject: p=reject: domain requests rejection of DMARC-failing messages.
verify.dmarc_reject_partial: p=reject (requested for {pct}% of messages): domain requests rejection of DMARC-failing messages.
verify.dmarc_quarantine: p=quarantine: domain requests quarantine of DMARC-failing messages.
verify.dmarc_quarantine_partial: p=quarantine (requested for {pct}% of messages): domain requests quarantine of DMARC-failing messages.
verify.dmarc_none: p=none: monitoring only — no enforcement requested.
verify.dmarc_missing: No DMARC record at _dmarc.{domain} — no anti-spoofing policy set.
verify.age_very_new: Domain is only {days} days old — newly registered domains are a major phishing red flag.
verify.age_new: Domain is {days} days old (~{months} months) — relatively new, proceed with caution.
verify.age_under_year: Domain is {days} days old (< 1 year) — moderately established.
verify.age_no_date: WHOIS returned no creation date for this domain.
verify.age_failed: WHOIS lookup failed or data unavailable: {error}
verify.ptr_missing_ip: No PTR record for MX server {ip} — legitimate mail servers almost always have reverse DNS configured.
verify.ptr_missing: No PTR record for MX server — legitimate mail servers almost always have reverse DNS configured.
